description: Containment, corrective and preventive actions with effectiveness verification.
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

records.description: Update the BMS balancing algorithm to increase balancing current availability during parked periods and extend the balancing window.
records.effectiveness_verification: Fleet cell spread monitoring over 30 days after update deployment.

records.description: Add a parked self-discharge spread case to the balancing sizing input specification for all future pack programmes.
records.effectiveness_verification: Specification review sign-off and application on the next programme.

records.description: Re-establish laser focus position and rework the affected modules.
records.effectiveness_verification: Weld resistance measurement on 100 percent of reworked modules.

records.description: Add focus verification as a mandatory step in the fixture change control plan.
records.effectiveness_verification: Control plan audit and verification of the first three fixture changes.

records.description: Quarantine and 100 percent leak test all cooling plates from the affected production weeks.
records.effectiveness_verification: Leak test records for the full quarantined population.

records.description: Reset the furnace dew point alarm threshold to the qualified limit and requalify the furnace profile.
records.effectiveness_verification: Furnace requalification report and sectioning results on the first qualified batch.

records.description: Sort and segregate all bushing stock from the transferred location and revert to the incumbent source until capability is demonstrated.
records.effectiveness_verification: Incoming stiffness measurement on the segregated population.

records.description: Requalify the cure oven profile at the transferred location and demonstrate process capability on stiffness.
records.effectiveness_verification: Process capability study on a minimum of 30 consecutive batches.

records.description: Add mandatory cure profile requalification to the standard process transfer checklist.
records.effectiveness_verification: Checklist revision approval and application on the next transfer.

records.description: Introduce protective packaging and revise the work instruction to specify vent handling protection.
records.effectiveness_verification: Vent flow verification pass rate over the following 500 packs.
